results.description:
She's a public defender who's tired of watching monsters walk free. He's an ex-cop turned outlaw who delivers the justice the courts won't.

When Lana Rhodes kicks down a door to find her teenage client beaten unconscious, she knows the system has failed again. Three girls from her caseload have been brutally attacked, and the cops are covering it up.

Enter Marcus "Smoke" Sullivan—dangerous, deadly, and president of the Reckoning Riders MC. He offers her something the courts never could: real justice for the children being trafficked in his territory.

But partnering with an outlaw motorcycle club means abandoning everything she's ever believed in.

Smoke's been hunting the monsters who prey on innocents ever since corrupt cops destroyed his life. When the fierce blonde lawyer storms into his garage demanding action, he sees a kindred spirit—someone willing to fight dirty for the right reasons.

Together, they'll wage war against a trafficking network protected by corrupt officials.

As bullets fly and bodies drop, their partnership ignites into something neither expected. She's proving herself as deadly as any of his brothers. He's showing her what it means to be truly protected.

But Vincent McGwire won't go down without a fight, and he's bringing military weapons to eliminate the lawyer who threatens his empire.

In a world where the system protects predators, sometimes you have to become an outlaw to serve justice.

A scorching hot MC romance where love and vengeance ride together.
